slides.title: Support leads need to trust a reply before it goes out
slides.body: Deskhand is for online shops with one to ten support agents. Each draft shows the order or help article behind every fact.

slides.body: Ticket #2291: a lamp arrived cracked, and the customer wants a refund.

slides.title: Ticket #2291 gets a cited reply in one view

image.alt: Deskhand console, cropped to the open ticket. Ticket #2291 from Priya N. reads: The Orla lamp arrived with a cracked base. Can I get a refund? The draft reply offers an $84.00 refund for order #48213 and highlights three claims, numbered 1 to 3. Lines link each claim to its source: Returns and refunds, Order #48213, and Payments. The approval bar reads: Refund $84 is over your $50 limit, with an Approve and send button.
image.source: Capture of the Deskhand demo page, Brand Studio showcase, 25 Sep 2026
